dx_dlbcl_gcb.quote: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, not otherwise specified (DLBCL, NOS), germinal-center B-cell-like (GCB) immunophenotype by the Hans algorithm.

stage_iv.quote: Ann Arbor stage IVB. There is a large (9.4 cm) conglomerate

stage_extranodal_sites.quote: with three extranodal sites: right kidney, left adrenal gland, and liver segment VI

stage_b_symptoms.quote: B symptoms are present: drenching night sweats and greater than 10% unintentional weight loss

mol_not_de_not_dh.quote: so it is not high-grade B-cell lymphoma with double-hit/triple-hit biology; it is also not a double-expressor

prog_ipi_high.quote: Standard IPI is 5/5 (age >60, stage III/IV, more than one extranodal site, ECOG performance status 2, elevated LDH)

prog_cns_ipi_high.quote: CNS-IPI is also 6/6 (age >60, ECOG >1, stage III/IV, more than one extranodal site, kidney/adrenal involvement, elevated LDH)

tx_curative_pola_or_rchop.quote: I recommend curative-intent Pola-R-CHP for 6 cycles every 21 days

tx_pola_preferred.quote: If polatuzumab is not accessible or not approved, R-CHOP for 6 cycles is the appropriate alternative standard.

mn_dose_reduced_initial.quote: I would not default to reduced-intensity R-miniCHOP.

cns_risk_addressed.quote: High risk: CNS-IPI 6/6, including kidney and adrenal involvement

cns_staging_mri_csf.quote: MRI brain is indicated if there are neurologic symptoms or if CSF is positive
cns_staging_mri_csf.note: LP with cytology/flow is planned but baseline MRI brain is made conditional, not routine.

cns_prophylaxis_renal.quote: because intravenous high-dose methotrexate is relatively unattractive with an eGFR of about 50 mL/min and ECOG 2
cns_prophylaxis_renal.note: Commits to IT MTX rather than presenting prophylaxis as individualized, but does tie HD-MTX to renal function and acknowledges uncertain benefit.

resp_eot_pet_lugano.quote: Restage with FDG PET-CT from skull base to mid-thigh about 6-8 weeks after cycle 6, interpreted using Lugano 2014/Deauville criteria.

resp_ds45_biopsy.quote: Deauville 4-5 requires correlation with CT; if a residual mass is present and accessible, biopsy

sup_tls_prophylaxis.quote: monitor potassium, phosphate, calcium, uric acid, and creatinine frequently
sup_tls_prophylaxis.note: Hydration and allopurinol ordered, but lab frequency is only 'frequently' without the q6-12h specification required.

sup_rasburicase_g6pd.quote: check G6PD before considering rasburicase 0.2 mg/kg for cycle 1 if hyperuricemia persists
sup_rasburicase_g6pd.note: G6PD checked but rasburicase only conditional/second-line after allopurinol rather than favored.

sup_gcsf.quote: Use primary G-CSF prophylaxis with pegfilgrastim 6 mg on day 2 because of age >65

sup_stop_nsaid.quote: Stop ibuprofen and avoid all NSAIDs because of renal dysfunction, bleeding risk, and fever masking; use acetaminophen

sup_steroid_glucose.quote: monitor glucose closely because prednisone will worsen his HbA1c of 7.4%

work_hbv_reviewed.quote: hepatitis B serologies (HBsAg negative, anti-HBc negative, anti-HBs positive, indicating immunity and no need for antiviral prophylaxis)

work_echo_reviewed.quote: He has no absolute contraindication to full-dose anthracycline-based therapy

fit_ecog_disease_related.quote: his performance status is probably worsened by the lymphoma and B symptoms
